rewritten_query:
WITH store_sales_q AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_county,
        SUM(CASE WHEN dd.d_qoy = 1 THEN st.ss_ext_sales_price END) AS store_q1,
        SUM(CASE WHEN dd.d_qoy = 2 THEN st.ss_ext_sales_price END) AS store_q2,
        SUM(CASE WHEN dd.d_qoy = 3 THEN st.ss_ext_sales_price END) AS store_q3
    FROM store_sales st
    JOIN date_dim dd ON st.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON st.ss_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN item i ON st.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_color IN ('cornflower', 'pink')
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 33
      AND st.ss_list_price BETWEEN 137 AND 151
      AND ca.ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL')
      AND dd.d_year = 2001
      AND dd.d_qoy IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY ca.ca_county
),
web_sales_q AS (
    SELECT
        ca.ca_county,
        SUM(CASE WHEN dd.d_qoy = 1 THEN wb.ws_ext_sales_price END) AS web_q1,
        SUM(CASE WHEN dd.d_qoy = 2 THEN wb.ws_ext_sales_price END) AS web_q2,
        SUM(CASE WHEN dd.d_qoy = 3 THEN wb.ws_ext_sales_price END) AS web_q3
    FROM web_sales wb
    JOIN date_dim dd ON wb.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ca ON wb.ws_bill_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
    JOIN item i ON wb.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
    WHERE i.i_color IN ('cornflower', 'pink')
      AND i.i_manager_id BETWEEN 14 AND 33
      AND wb.ws_list_price BETWEEN 137 AND 151
      AND ca.ca_state IN ('GA', 'IL')
      AND dd.d_year = 2001
      AND dd.d_qoy IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY ca.ca_county
)
SELECT
    s.ca_county,
    2001 AS d_year,
    w.web_q2 / NULLIF(w.web_q1, 0) AS web_q1_q2_increase,
    s.store_q2 / NULLIF(s.store_q1, 0) AS store_q1_q2_increase,
    w.web_q3 / NULLIF(w.web_q2, 0) AS web_q2_q3_increase,
    s.store_q3 / NULLIF(s.store_q2, 0) AS store_q2_q3_increase
FROM store_sales_q s
JOIN web_sales_q w ON s.ca_county = w.ca_county
WHERE s.store_q1 > 0
  AND w.web_q1 > 0
  AND s.store_q2 > 0
  AND w.web_q2 > 0
  AND s.store_q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND w.web_q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND w.web_q2 / NULLIF(w.web_q1, 0) > s.store_q2 / NULLIF(s.store_q1, 0)
  AND w.web_q3 / NULLIF(w.web_q2, 0) > s.store_q3 / NULLIF(s.store_q2, 0)
ORDER BY d_year;

rewrite_suggestion.produced_suggestion: Push d_year = 2001 and d_qoy IN (1,2,3) into both CTE definitions instead of filtering only in the outer query. Since the CTEs are referenced multiple times, the original query materializes them over all years/quarters, causing unnecessary aggregation.

Replace the six self-joins on materialized CTEs with a single row per county using conditional aggregation (SUM(CASE WHEN d_qoy = ...)). This removes repeated CTE scans and reduces the final join from 5 joins to 1.
Use explicit ANSI JOIN syntax instead of comma joins for better readability and clearer join semantics.
Fold the constant year 2001 into the CTE predicates and directly output 2001 AS d_year, avoiding repeated d_year filtering in the outer joins.

Replace CASE WHEN denom > 0 THEN num/denom ELSE NULL END comparisons with explicit positivity predicates plus NULLIF-guarded divisions, preserving original null/zero semantics while avoiding division-by-zero risk.
